audit.whatIsWrong: The page says four separate times — whys[5], spikes[2], late and wants.you[1] — that Purge cleanses Darius's bleed. It does not. spikes[1] also calls Fear Beyond Death 'a hard counter' to Noxian Guillotine that lets you 'flip him mid-pull'.
audit.why: Riot's Purge text is: Urgot slows himself while unloading his weapon on nearby enemies, prioritising champions he has recently struck, and triggering Echoing Flames. There is no cleanse, no tenacity, nothing that touches Hemorrhage stacks. Nothing in either kit settles whether Disdain interrupts his R leap either, so the hard-counter claim is not supportable.
audit.corrected: Every cleanse claim replaced with the real answer to his sustain — Grievous Wounds against Decimate's blade heal — and the level-6 line rebuilt on Noxian Guillotine's real properties: true damage, 120s at rank 1, refreshed by a kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect list says it outright: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, zero sequencing cues. Apprehend is the tracked cooldown on every screen and its number is never given.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — the longest lane cooldown in this matchup by a distance, and 535 range against Corrosive Charge's 800. A dodged pull buys nearly half a minute of free spacing. Crippling Strike is a 5s auto reset; Noxian Guillotine 120s.
audit.corrected: 26s, 535 vs 800, 5s and 120s written into the phases, spikes, late and cooldown breakdown, each attached to a 'wait for X then Y' instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows read Urgot including Level 1, where whys[0] itself says the lane is even. The mirror sets Level 1 to Darius.
audit.why: Decimate's blade heals him through a level-1 auto trade, which is why the mirror gave him that row at 6.5/10 on his side. Levels 2 onward stay Urgot, matching the 55.23% win rate over 2334 games.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] to Darius at 4/10; the rest of the chart untouched.

edits.before: Q start for safe poke. Each auto fires an Echoing Flames leg — chunk Darius on every last-hit, but don't burn all six legs into one trade.
edits.after: His level: Decimate's blade edge heals him and beats a level-1 auto trade. Take Q, poke, and refuse the brawl at the minion line.

edits.before: Q and W ranks make the grind trades brutal. Force Darius to choose between CS and health; he can't have both into your spray.
edits.after: Still yours, but Crippling Strike is a 5s auto reset — step out on the wind-up, not the cast, or the slow pins you in Decimate.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend (Pull): matchup-defining — His all-in starts on the pull. Stay spaced. Track it before every engage. - Darius Apprehend: Pulls all enemies in a cone toward him and grants armor pen — his engage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — 26s at rank 1, 535 range, and it passively gives him percent armour penetration. Stay spaced. - Darius Noxian Guillotine: 120s at rank 1, true damage, and a kill refreshes it.

edits.before: His all-in starts on the pull. Stay spaced. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 26s at rank 1 and his all-in starts on it. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — his Q heal and E pull threat balance your range advantage.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Decimate's blade heals him through your auto trade.

edits.before: At 6 your R hard-counters his Guillotine, flipping his execute back on him.
edits.after: At 6 you race him: his Guillotine is true damage, yours has 2500 range.

edits.after: First item keeps you ahead once Grievous Wounds cuts his Decimate heal.

edits.before: Your Q outranges Darius' whole kit — poke him with leg-zones from outside his E pull and W-shred any minion he stacks bleed on, never letting him land the outer-edge Q heal.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 and Apprehend only 535 — poke from inside that gap, and never let him land Decimate's outer blade, which is the half that heals him off you.

edits.before: R Fear Beyond Death is a hard counter to his R Noxian Guillotine: you can flip him mid-pull, and your execute triggers off the same low health he's trying to reset off.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage on 120s at rank 1 and refreshes on a kill, so armour will not save you when low. Hold Fear Beyond Death for the moment he spends Apprehend, not before.

notes: The worst defect on this page is a mechanic Urgot does not have: four strings told the reader Purge cleanses Darius's bleed. Riot's Purge text has no cleanse of any kind, and 'needsResearch' being empty means unknown, not confirmed — so I replaced the advice with the answer that is verifiable, Grievous Wounds against Decimate's blade heal. Also removed rather than reversed: the claim that Fear Beyond Death hard-counters Noxian Guillotine and can flip him mid-pull. Nothing in either kit settles CC priority against his R leap. Left as-is per the mirror: Corrosive Charge's 'dash' flag contradicts Riot's description and was not used.
